reason: A static Skill that provides guidance for planning and running auditable GitHub Issue and Pull Request campaigns, with declared GitHub read/write scopes supplied by an external provider.

summaries.zh: 为用户规划并执行可审计的 GitHub Issue 和 Pull Request 活动提供静态指导，并依赖用户选择的提供方授予 GitHub 权限。
summaries.en: Provides static guidance for planning and running auditable GitHub Issue and Pull Request campaigns using permissions supplied by the user’s chosen provider.

capabilities: Guides planning and execution of GitHub Issue and Pull Request campaigns
May support GitHub read and write operations when authorized by the user's provider
